title: 第0019章 白鲜净毒绝境反杀第0020章 仙茅破障一拳惊四座

第0019章：白鲜净毒，绝境反杀！
------
林啸天脸上的狞笑彻底僵住了，如同风化千年的岩石，寸寸龟裂。他精心布置的“锁灵阵”，引以为傲的家族护卫队，在那青衫少年的铁拳之下，竟如土鸡瓦狗，不堪一击。
烟尘缓缓散去，露出林药尘那张平静得令人心悸的脸庞。他站在废墟之上，衣袂虽有破损，但身姿挺拔如松，周身那属于药徒四重的气息如同潮汐般滚滚荡荡，压得在场所有人喘不过气来。
“少……少主，救我……”一名重伤的护卫伸出手，哀求地看向林啸天。
林啸天猛地回过神来，眼中的惊恐瞬间被滔天的怒火与怨毒所取代。他死死地盯着林药尘，牙齿咬得咯咯作响，仿佛要将林药尘生吞活剥。
“林药尘！你这孽障！竟敢杀伤家族护卫，你这是叛族！是大罪！”林啸天色厉内荏地嘶吼着，试图用所谓的“族规”来压制林药尘，尽管他自己心里清楚，林药尘早已被除名，族规对他而言已是废纸。
“叛族？”林药尘闻言，不禁失笑，笑声中满是嘲讽，“林啸天，在我身中腐骨散、经脉寸断被扔出林家大门的时候，你可曾想过族规？在我被家族旁系子弟肆意欺凌的时候，你可曾想过族规？现在，我靠自己的本事站起来，你却拿族规来压我？”
他向前迈了一步，脚下的碎石被震得四散飞溅。
“林家的族规，从来都是你们这些高高在上的人用来欺压弱者的工具罢了。今日，我林药尘在此，不谈族规，只谈因果！你欠我的，该还了！”
话音未落，林药尘身形一动，再次化作一道青色残影，直扑林啸天！
“拦住他！快拦住他！”林啸天吓得魂飞魄散，哪里还有半分少主的威风，转身就想往府邸深处跑去。他虽然也有药徒四重巅峰的修为，但刚才亲眼目睹了林药尘一拳轰飞淬体七重，又一人横扫七星斩灵阵的恐怖战力，心底早已生出了不可战胜的阴影。
“想走？晚了！”
林药尘的速度极快，眨眼间便追至林啸天身后，一掌拍向其后心。掌风中带着仙茅的刚猛与仙鹤草的绵长，正是《万古药尊诀》中的基础掌法——【药香掌】。
“不要！”林啸天感受到身后传来的致命危机，发出一声凄厉的惨叫。
就在这千钧一发之际，异变陡生！
“嗡——！”
一道刺目的血光突然从林啸天怀中爆发出来，形成一面血红色的盾牌，挡在了他身后。
“砰！”
林药尘的掌力结结实实地印在血色盾牌之上，发出一声闷响。盾牌剧烈震颤，表面泛起涟漪，却并未破碎，反而将林药尘震退了两步。

“嗯？”林药尘稳住身形，眼中闪过一丝诧异。
“哈哈哈！林药尘，你杀不了我！”林啸天感受到那层保护，顿时狂喜起来，他转过身，脸上重新挂上了那令人作呕的得意笑容，“你以为我就没有底牌吗？这可是我父亲留给我的‘血玉护身符’，专门克制你这种偷袭！你杀不了我！”
林药尘冷冷地看着他，并没有因为一时的受阻而惊慌。他敏锐地察觉到，那血色盾牌之上，散发着一股极其隐晦、令人作呕的阴冷气息。
“血玉护身符？”林药尘眯起眼睛，系统面板自动弹出，对那血玉进行了扫描。
【物品：血玉护身符（残缺）】
【品质：凡级下品（蕴含一丝邪修血煞之气）】
【介绍：以活人精血温养而成的玉符，可抵挡三次药徒境全力一击。因温养方式不正，长期佩戴会导致使用者性情暴躁，经脉受阴寒之气侵蚀。】
“邪修血煞之气？”林药尘心中冷笑，“难怪林啸天最近行事越发乖张，原来是有邪修在背后给他撑腰。林家，果然已经烂透了。”
“林药尘，你不是很狂吗？再来啊！”林啸天见林药尘沉默，以为他束手无策，顿时气焰更加嚣张，从怀中掏出一把黑色的粉末，狞笑道，“既然你找死，那就别怪我心狠手辣！这是我从黑市花大价钱买的‘蚀骨散’，专破护体气劲！你去死吧！”
说着，他猛地将黑色粉末朝着林药尘一扬！
漫天黑粉如同烟雾般弥漫开来，带着一股刺鼻的腥甜味。这蚀骨散不同于之前的腐骨散，腐骨散主要是破坏经脉，而这蚀骨散则是直接腐蚀药力与护体罡气，一旦沾染，神仙难救！
“小心！”围观的人群中发出一声惊呼，是为林药尘担忧的声音。
面对这猝不及防的毒粉攻击，林药尘却是不闪不避，眼中反而闪过一抹兴奋的寒光。
“来得正好！我正愁找不到机会试验【白鲜皮】的真正威力！”
在黑粉即将沾染身体的瞬间，林药尘心念一动，体内那株一直沉寂的本命奇药——白鲜皮，终于绽放出属于它的光芒！
如果说仙茅是狂暴的火焰，仙鹤草是温和的春风，那么白鲜皮就是凛冽的寒风，带着净化一切的肃杀之意！

Chapter 0019: Bai Xian purifies poison, counterattack in desperate situation!
------
The ferocious smile on Lin Xiaotian's face completely froze, like a rock that had been weathered for thousands of years, cracked inch by inch. The "Spirit Locking Formation" he had carefully arranged and the family escorts he was proud of were as vulnerable to a single blow as the iron fist of the young man in green shirt.
The smoke slowly dispersed, revealing Lin Yaochen's heart-stoppingly calm face. He stood on top of the ruins. Although his clothes were damaged, his posture was as straight as a pine tree. The aura of the fourth-level medicine disciple around him was rolling like a tidal wave, making everyone present breathless.
"Young... Young Master, save me..." A seriously injured guard stretched out his hand and looked at Lin Xiaotian pleadingly.
Lin Xiaotian suddenly came to his senses, and the panic in his eyes was instantly replaced by overwhelming anger and resentment. He stared at Lin Yaochen, his teeth clenching as if he wanted to eat Lin Yaochen alive.
"Lin Yaochen! You evildoer! You dare to kill and injure the family guards. You are treason to the clan! It is a grave crime!" Lin Xiaotian roared fiercely, trying to use the so-called "clan rules" to suppress Lin Yaochen, even though he knew in his heart that Lin Yaochen had been removed from the clan long ago, and the clan rules were useless to him.
"Rebel?" Lin Yaochen couldn't help laughing when he heard this, and his laughter was full of ridicule, "Lin Xiaotian, when I was thrown out of the Lin family gate with rotten bones and broken meridians, did you ever think about the clan rules? When I was wantonly bullied by the descendants of the family, did you ever think about the clan rules? Now, I stand up on my own ability, but you use the clan rules to suppress me?"
He took a step forward, and the gravel beneath his feet was scattered in all directions.
"The Lin family's clan rules have always been a tool used by you superiors to bully the weak. Today, I, Lin Yaochen, am here. I don't talk about clan rules, only about cause and effect! It's time to pay back what you owe me!"
Before he finished speaking, Lin Yaochen moved and turned into a cyan afterimage again, heading straight towards Lin Xiaotian!
"Stop him! Stop him quickly!" Lin Xiaotian was so frightened that he lost even half of the majesty of the young master. He turned around and wanted to run deep into the mansion. Although he also has the cultivation level of the fourth level of the peak medicine disciple, but he just witnessed Lin Yaochen's punch blowing away the seventh level of body tempering, and the terrifying combat power of another person sweeping through the seven-star spirit-slaying formation, the shadow of invincibility has already arisen in his heart.
"Want to leave? It's too late!"
Lin Yaochen was extremely fast. He caught up behind Lin Xiaotian in the blink of an eye and slapped him in the back of the heart. The palm wind carries the fierceness of curculigo and the length of agrimony, which is the basic palm technique in "Eternal Medicine Master Technique" - [Medicine Fragrance Palm].
"No!" Lin Xiaotian felt the fatal crisis coming from behind him and let out a shrill scream.
At this critical moment, a sudden change occurred!
“Buzz——!”
A dazzling bloody light suddenly erupted from Lin Xiaotian's arms, forming a blood-red shield behind him.
"Bang!"
Lin Yaochen's palm force was firmly printed on the bloody shield, making a muffled sound. The shield trembled violently and rippled on the surface, but it did not break. Instead, it knocked Lin Yaochen back two steps.
"Huh?" Lin Yaochen stabilized his figure, a trace of surprise flashed in his eyes.
"Hahaha! Lin Yaochen, you can't kill me!" Lin Xiaotian felt that layer of protection and suddenly became ecstatic. He turned around and put that disgusting proud smile on his face again, "Do you think I don't have a trump card? This is the 'Blood Jade Amulet' my father left me, specifically to restrain sneak attacks like yours! You can't kill me!"
Lin Yaochen looked at him coldly, not panicking because of the temporary hindrance. He was keenly aware that there was an extremely obscure and disgusting cold aura exuding from the bloody shield.
"Blood jade amulet?" Lin Yaochen narrowed his eyes, and the system panel automatically popped up and scanned the blood jade.
[Item: Blood Jade Amulet (Incomplete)]
[Quality: low-grade ordinary grade (contains aSilk Evil Cultivating Blood Evil Qi)】
[Introduction: A jade talisman warmed by the essence and blood of a living person can withstand three full blows from the Medicine Apprentice Realm. Due to improper warming and nourishing methods, long-term wearing will cause the user to be irritable and the meridians will be eroded by cold and yin energy. 】
"The evil cultivator's blood evil spirit?" Lin Yaochen sneered in his heart, "No wonder Lin Xiaotian has been acting more and more erratically recently. It turns out that there is an evil cultivator supporting him behind his back. The Lin family is indeed rotten."
"Lin Yaochen, aren't you crazy? Come again!" Seeing Lin Yaochen's silence, Lin Xiaotian thought he was helpless. He suddenly became more arrogant, took out a handful of black powder from his arms, and said with a ferocious smile, "Since you are looking for death, don't blame me for being ruthless! This is the 'Bone Erosion Powder' I bought from the black market at a huge price. It is designed to break the body's energy! Go to hell!"
As he spoke, he suddenly threw the black powder towards Lin Yaochen!
The black powder filled the sky like smoke, carrying a pungent fishy sweet taste. This Bone Corroding Powder is different from the previous Corroding Bone Powder. The Corroding Bone Powder mainly destroys the meridians, but this Bone Corroding Powder directly corrodes the medicinal power and body-protecting Qi. Once contaminated, it will be difficult for the gods to save you!
"Be careful!" A cry came from the crowd of onlookers, a worried voice for Lin Yaochen.
Faced with this unexpected poisonous powder attack, Lin Yaochen did not dodge, but a glimmer of excitement flashed in his eyes.
"Just in time! I was worried that I wouldn't find a chance to test the true power of [White Fresh Skin]!"
At the moment when the black powder was about to contaminate his body, Lin Yaochen had a thought in his mind. The miraculous medicine of his life that had been silent all this time, Bai Xianpi, finally bloomed with its light!
If curculigo is a violent flame and agrimony is a gentle spring breeze, then white fresh bark is a biting cold wind, with a chilling meaning that purifies everything!
